title.zh: Clash Verge Rev TUN 模式与虚拟网卡深度调优：绕过系统代理实现终端命令与游戏全局接管
title.en: Clash Verge Rev TUN Mode & Virtual NIC Tuning: Bypassing System Proxy for Full CLI & Gaming Capture

description.zh: 深入剖析 Clash Verge Rev 原生 TUN 虚拟网卡接管原理。详解 Windows Wintun 与 macOS utun 驱动安装、Fake-IP 智能解析、终端命令行（Git/SSH/Docker）免配代理与外服游戏联机低延迟优化。
description.en: Comprehensive guide to configuring native TUN virtual network interface mode in Clash Verge Rev. Learn how Wintun and utun drivers capture OSI Layer 3 traffic for terminal tools, Docker, and gaming without manual proxy settings.
